name: Battle Frontier
description:
About This Game

Experience our creature-collecting, power-merging RPG with a PVP twist. Challenge, capture and train numerous BattleBeasts - Merge with them and master their powers to gain the advantage in numerous online multiplayer competitions. Compete against the Galaxy's best fighters to earn the title of Battle Frontier Champion.

  • Challenging Third Person Fighting Game Combat (Combos, Blocks, Dodges)

  • Monster Taming, Training and Evolving (BattleBeasts)

  • Merging with your BattleBeast into a hybrid form

  • Competitive and cooperative multiplayer

  • Exploring the exciting planet of Almana

The famous Battle Frontier Grand Tournament calls! And following this call, you embark on an exciting battle journey across the diverse and wondrous world of Almana.

On this journey, you (a young “BattleRookie”) will not only meet new friends and explore mysterious places but also collect powerful creatures to fuse with, making this dangerous journey much more manageable.

These strange creatures are called BattleBeasts, and there’s nothing they love more than healthy competition and combat training.

You can equip up to four BattleBeasts in your party and switch between them to always have one walking by your side or to merge with. Depending on your choice, you will have different opportunities to interact with the world.

Find and assemble your perfect BattleBeast team and become the Battle Frontier Champion!
short_desc: Master deep third-person combat as you explore a world filled with powerful creatures to collect. Merge with your BattleBeasts to unlock their abilities, uncover the mysteries of Almana or dominate the arena in online multiplayer.
